title: Canadian Butter Tarts
hookLine: Canadian-inspired canadian butter tarts with 8 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven to fan 170C/ conventional 190C/gas 5. Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface so it’s slightly thinner than straight from the pack. Then cut out 18-20 rounds with a 7.5cm fluted cutter, re-rolling the trimmings. Use the rounds to line two deep 12-hole tart tins (not muffin tins). If you only have a regular-sized, 12-hole tart tin you will be able to make a few more slightly shallower tarts. Incorporate {m52923_1}, {m52923_2}, {m52923_3}, and {m52923_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure shortcrust pastry first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Beat the eggs in a large bowl and combine with the rest of the ingredients except the walnuts. Tip this mixture into a pan and stir continuously for 3-4 minutes until the butter melts, and the mixture bubbles and starts to thicken. It should be thick enough to coat the back of a wooden spoon. Don’t overcook, and be sure to stir all the time as the mixture can easily burn. Remove from the heat and stir in the nuts. Incorporate {m52923_5}, {m52923_6}, {m52923_7}, and {m52923_8} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Bake Canadian Butter Tarts & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 30 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Spoon the filling into the unbaked tart shells so it’s level with the pastry. Bake for 15-18 minutes until set and pale golden. Leave in the tin to cool for a few minutes before lifting out on to a wire rack. Serve warm or cold.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
